name: Himeko • Nova
description:
Some fight side by side, some keep watch. The Trailblaze is never a lonely voyage.
She paints a trailblazing miracle. The silver rail stretches on, and the Nameless set sail once more, illuminating the galaxy's eternal night.
At the end of the line, she looks back once again. The dream of setting forth has never run aground.

skills.name: Enkindle the First Lodestar
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy.

skills.name: Upraise the Vanward Cresset
skills.desc: After using Skill, immediately recovers all Assist Skill uses. Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore," lasting for #2[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Himeko • Nova's every turn. When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt by all allies increases by #1[i]%. At the start of every turn, immediately recovers 1 Assist Skill use.
skills.simpleDesc: After using Skill, immediately recovers all Assist Skill uses. Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore." When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt increases. At the start of every turn, immediately regains 1 Assist Skill use.

extra.name: Assist Skill
extra.desc: An extra ability that can be granted to an ally target. Using an Assist Skill will also consume the current action turn.

skills.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
skills.desc:
Immediately takes control of "Starblazer." "Starblazer" can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" against enemies 6 times, or consume "Source Energy" to launch "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," dealing Fire DMG up to #9[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG up to #10[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to other targets.
When the uses of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" are depleted, automatically launches "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," followed by Final Hit, dealing #6[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to #7[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
When "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field, or when enemy HP can no longer be reduced, immediately launches Final Hit.
skills.simpleDesc: During the Ultimate, can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" on all enemies. At the end, deals Fire DMG to #6[i] random single enemies.

skills.name: Of Fire and Far Faring
skills.desc:
While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the Territory "Starblazer Visioscape," summoning "Starblazer" to the field and granting all ally characters 1 Assist Skill use. Ally characters can use Assist Skill to call upon "Starblazer" to attack enemies.
Using Assist Skill is considered as Himeko • Nova using her Skill. Himeko • Nova gains #2[i]% increased All-Type RES PEN and #1[i]% increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, can ignore Weakness Types to reduce enemy Toughness. When breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use their Assist Skill, regenerates #3[i] Energy for them.
skills.simpleDesc:
When Himeko • Nova is on the field, deploys a Territory, granting all ally characters Assist Skill. When an ally character uses Assist Skill, Himeko • Nova gains increased All-Type RES PEN and increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, ignores Weakness Types to reduce Toughness.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use Assist Skill, regenerates Energy for them.

extra.name: Territory
extra.desc: Territory effects are unique in the battle. While it exists, other abilities with Territory effects cannot be used.

extra.name: Assist Skill
extra.desc: An extra ability that can be granted to an ally target. Using an Assist Skill will also consume the current action turn.

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

skills.name: Starcharter Cruise
skills.desc:
When Himeko • Nova is in the team, increases the max Technique Points by 3.
After using Technique, enters the "Cruise" state for #1[i] seconds. Actively using the Technique consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, immediately uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.
If attacking a Normal Enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.
skills.simpleDesc:
Increases the max Technique Points by 3. After actively using Technique, enters the "Cruise" state and consumes 2 Technique Points to attack all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.
If attacking a Normal Enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

eidolons.name: That Which We Stride Is the Trailblaze
eidolons.desc: The number of extra <u>Assist Skill</u> uses from Talent additionally increases by <nobr>1</nobr>. While in the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state, reduces the number of Ultimate uses required to launch <u>Assist Skill</u> by <nobr>1</nobr>. While in the "Companion Protocol: Decimation" state, reduces the Charge required to launch <u>Assist Skill</u> by <nobr>3</nobr>. When Himeko • Nova launches <u>Assist Skill</u>, the number of extra DMG instances increases by <nobr>1</nobr>.

extra.name: Assist Skill
extra.desc: An extra ability that can be granted to an ally target. Using an Assist Skill will also consume the current action turn.

eidolons.name: The Colors We Never Strike
eidolons.desc: The cap of Himeko • Nova's <u>Assist Skill</u> uses increases to 2, and the DMG dealt by Ultimate and <u>Assist Skill</u> becomes <nobr>130%</nobr> of their original DMG. During the "Navigator's Semaphore" state, at the start of each turn, additionally recovers 1 use of <u>Assist Skill</u> immediately. When a non-<u>Trailblaze Companions</u> character uses <u>Assist Skill</u>, the Trace "Hark! The Express's Pulse Roars" now also grants them 1 <u>extra turn</u>.

extra.name: Assist Skill
extra.desc: An extra ability that can be granted to an ally target. Using an Assist Skill will also consume the current action turn.

extra.name: Trailblaze Companions
extra.desc: Trailblazer, Himeko, Himeko • Nova, March 7th, Evernight, Dan Heng, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, Welt, Sunday.

eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>10</nobr>.

eidolons.desc: When using <u>Assist Skill</u> via the Talent "Of Fire and Far Faring," the All-Type RES PEN boost now applies to all allies. And when Himeko • Nova gains this effect, her All-Type RES PEN additionally increases by <nobr>10%</nobr>.

eidolons.name: To Cross the Cosmos and Beyond
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Ours Is the Oath to Sail Starward
eidolons.desc: Himeko • Nova's Fire <u>RES PEN</u> increases by <nobr>20%</nobr>. The cap of <u>"Source Energy"</u> increases to <nobr>6</nobr>. When an ally uses or launches <u>Assist Skill</u>, DMG dealt by <u>Assist Skill</u> increases by <nobr>75%</nobr>, and Himeko • Nova gains 1 <u>"Source Energy."</u> When launching "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" during Ultimate, additionally gains 1 <u>"Source Energy"</u>. When launching "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," if the current <u>"Source Energy"</u> is <nobr>6</nobr> or more, additionally deals 1 instance of Fire DMG to all enemies, equal to <nobr>160%</nobr> of Himeko • Nova's ATK.

embedBonusSkill.name: Whither, the Last and First Men?
embedBonusSkill.desc: When Himeko • Nova launches <u>Assist Skill</u>, it does not consume <u>Assist Skill</u> uses. At the start of the turn, if the <u>Assist Skill</u> uses have reached the current cap, Himeko • Nova additionally regenerates <nobr>5</nobr> Energy.

embedBonusSkill.name: Hark! The Express's Pulse Roars
embedBonusSkill.desc: When a <u>Trailblaze Companions</u> character other than Himeko • Nova uses <u>Assist Skill</u>, that character immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> in which they can insert the use of their Ultimate. The <u>extra turn</u> gained from <u>Assist Skill</u> will not repeatedly trigger this Trace effect.

embedBonusSkill.name: The Silver Rail, Hushed in Antiquity
embedBonusSkill.desc: When using Ultimate, immediately gains <nobr>3</nobr> <u>"Source Energy."</u> If the current <u>"Source Energy"</u> is <nobr>3</nobr> or more, when using the "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" attack, the DMG multiplier of "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" against random single enemies increases by <nobr>30%</nobr>.
